name: Rehearsal Unheard
source:
Following a recent car accident, Max's hearing aid has been replaced with new biotech. Help them navigate their anxiety while adapting to the new device. 

[From [url=https://34deoutono.itch.io/rehearsal-unheard]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经历前不久的一场车祸后，麦克斯的助听器被替换成了一款新型生物科技装置。陪伴麦克斯排解内心的焦虑，一步步适应这件新设备吧。

[摘自[url=https://34deoutono.itch.io/rehearsal-unheard]Itch.io[/url]]
